scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @eview-clips/api" "npm run dev --workspace @eview-clips/web" "npm run dev --workspace @eview-clips/worker"
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec -it db psql -U postgres -d eview_clips
scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U postgres -d eview_clips > backups/backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql
